about: The workspace screens that Trillion's web client (trillion-apps web/src/workspace) draws, moved byte for byte into the Workshop tool that owns the feature, each under its source path inside the tool. The ruling (the owner's ruling, 2026-11-03 1:02 AM CST): the engine and the web app keep only generic primitives, and features, screens and tools move one to one into Workshop tools. A group is owner_only: it moves the screen file and the helpers only that screen uses, and every file of the web shell they import stays where it is, imported as written; the client build answers those imports with the shell's files (web/scripts/workshop-shell-imports.mjs, from the tool's moved-from.json), and the page opens the screen as a screen module (web/scripts/screen-modules.mjs) named by its Workshop row.

groups.joins_tool: tools/notifications reads and sends a person's notices; this brings the screen where a person chooses which notices reach them and how (tool:screen-notification-settings)
groups.capability: choose which notices reach me and how
